_comment: Pages that are legitimately reached by URL rather than by an in-app link. Every entry needs a reason: an unexplained entry here is indistinguishable from a screen nobody can find, which is the exact defect this gate exists to catch.

directEntryPoints.reason: Site root. Reached by opening the domain, so no in-app link precedes it.
Deliberate legacy redirect to /practice, kept so existing bookmarks and external links continue to resolve. Nothing should link to it — that is the point.
